subject: maths
question: In a triangle LMN, OP is a line segment drawn parallel to the side MN. OP intersects the sides LM and LN at O and P, respectively. If LM = 15 cm, OM = 4 cm, and PN = 5 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of the side LN?
solution:
Given:

In ΔLMN, OP is a line segment drawn parallel to the side MN

OP intersects the sides LM and LN at O and P

LM = 15 cm, OM = 4 cm, and PN = 5 cm

Formula:

If ΔABC ∼ ΔPQR, then

AB/PQ= BC/QR = AC/PR

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8d3a0367889f0fe60e08fdb07a80d9533e5b59f4a529f4c51f3068647a962c5.png] 

LM/OM = = LN/PN

⇒ 15/4 = LN/5

⇒ LN = (15 × 5)/4

⇒ LN = 75/4 = 18.75 cm

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
